mapper.update:
update traverse
ward_id = #{wardId},
inhospital = #{inhospital},
care_status = #{careStatus},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select traverse.*, doctor.name as doctorName, ward.name as wardName from traverse left join ward on traverse.ward_id = ward.id left join doctor on traverse.doctor_id = doctor.id
and inhospital in ('已住院','待住院') and traverse.hospital_id= #{hospitalId}
